metadata.title: Seedance 2.5 API
metadata.description: Test and integrate Seedance 2.5 API for 4–30 second multimodal AI video generation and editing with native audio.

title: Seedance 2.5 API
description: Seedance 2.5 is ByteDance's unified multimodal video model for creating or reshaping 4–30 second clips from text, images, video, and audio references.
Use the live playground to validate prompts, reference assets, native audio, duration, resolution, and the exact request payload before integrating the same workflow into your product.
pricingNote: USD estimates use $0.005/credit with the best annual plan. Video-reference requests include both input and output duration in billing.

featuresTitle: Create and edit with one Seedance 2.5 API
featuresDescription: Direct the subject, movement, camera, timing, and sound with compatible reference assets, then retrieve the finished render through an asynchronous task workflow.

capabilities.title: Up to 50 references
capabilities.description: Use up to 30 images, 10 video clips, and 10 audio files in a compatible multimodal reference workflow.

capabilities.title: 4–30 second output
capabilities.description: Choose a precise output duration for short ads, social stories, product sequences, and cinematic concepts.

capabilities.title: Reference-led editing
capabilities.description: Guide an existing clip toward new motion, performance, camera treatment, pacing, or visual direction.

capabilities.title: Native audio
capabilities.description: Generate synchronized dialogue, ambience, effects, and music, or guide the result with audio references.

quickStartTitle: From model test to production request
quickStartDescription: Validate the exact Seedance 2.5 workflow in three steps before moving it into your application.

workflows.title: 1. Build the payload
workflows.description: Add a prompt, choose first/last frames or compatible multimodal references, then set duration, ratio, resolution, and audio.

workflows.title: 2. Create the task
workflows.description: Send the model ID and payload to the generation endpoint with your SdanceAI API key.

workflows.title: 3. Poll the result
workflows.description: Track the asynchronous task until it succeeds, then save or display the returned MP4 or MOV URL.

productionNotes.title: Account and credit controls
productionNotes.body: Tasks use your existing SdanceAI account, API key, credit balance, visibility settings, and generation history.

productionNotes.title: Two reference modes
productionNotes.body: Use first and last frames together, or use compatible image, video, and audio reference arrays; these modes cannot be combined in one request.

productionNotes.title: Usage-based pricing
productionNotes.body: Credits depend on resolution, output duration, and whether video input is present; video-reference billing includes input duration.

faqs.question: What is Seedance 2.5 API best for?
faqs.answer: It is best for multimodal video creation and editing where a product needs repeatable control over subjects, motion, camera language, timing, and native audio.

faqs.question: Which input types can I use?
faqs.answer: You can send a prompt, optional first and last frames, or compatible arrays of image, video, and audio references. First/last-frame mode cannot be combined with the multimodal reference arrays.

faqs.question: How many reference assets are supported?
faqs.answer: The current Seedance 2.5 schema supports up to 30 reference images, 10 reference videos, and 10 reference audio files in the compatible reference workflow.

faqs.question: What duration and resolution can I request?
faqs.answer: Output duration can be set from 4 to 30 seconds. The current model supports 480p and 720p output with common landscape, portrait, square, ultrawide, and adaptive aspect ratios.

faqs.question: Can Seedance 2.5 generate audio?
faqs.answer: Yes. Enable native audio for synchronized dialogue, ambience, sound effects, and music. Compatible audio files can also be included as references.

faqs.question: Can I edit an existing video?
faqs.answer: Yes. Add a reference video and describe the performance, motion, camera, timing, or visual treatment you want the new render to follow.

faqs.question: How do I receive the finished video?
faqs.answer: Create an asynchronous task, then poll the task endpoint using the returned task ID. A successful response includes the generated media URL.

faqs.question: Can I use Seedance 2.5 API commercially?
faqs.answer: The page supports commercial workflows. You remain responsible for your rights to prompts and reference media and should review the applicable plan and content-policy terms before production use.
